summary: E-2 AlembicAgent rework-3 after controller raw-evidence review. Rework-2 correctly fixed terminal.exec audit persistence by omitting/uniquing requestId, but controller source review found a separate E2-7 blocker: execInSandboxOrDirect still overwrites any sandboxExecutor-provided diagnostics with {sandboxed:true,fallbackUsed:false} after executor.exec returns. That makes the later Alembic ToolContextFactory bridge repair impossible to observe from Agent results, violating E2-7 sandbox degradation explicitness. Scope is ONLY this producer contract gap. Preserve all accepted E-2 behavior from prior rounds: structured terminalSafety allowlist/cwd jail, auditSink.log(entry), action terminal.exec, result/duration, data.commandHash only, no raw command text, audit failures non-fatal, and no stable commandHash-derived requestId. Change Agent terminal runtime so SandboxExecutorLike may return optional diagnostics {sandboxed:boolean,fallbackUsed:boolean,degradeReason?:string}; when present, preserve it instead of overwriting. When absent, keep the sandboxed:true/fallbackUsed:false default. Ensure the existing result decoration continues to set _meta.fallbackUsed and output [unsandboxed:<reason>] for fallback/degraded runs. Add a regression where a fake sandboxExecutor returns stdout/stderr/exitCode plus diagnostics {sandboxed:false,fallbackUsed:true,degradeReason:'seatbelt_unavailable'} and assert the terminal.exec ToolResult exposes fallbackUsed plus the unsandboxed diagnostic; this must prove an Alembic bridge can pass degradation through. Keep the existing missing-sandboxExecutor fallback and repeated-audit tests. Do not expand into E-1 allowlist consumer, E-3 dead-stack deletion/public subpath retirement, E-4 phantom cleanup, E-5 prompt/guard, or Alembic main wiring. Validate with Node >=22: targeted runtime terminal safety tests, build:check, tool-v2 contract/public-signature checks as affected, and grep showing no terminal.exec:<hash> requestId and no diagnostics overwrite. Commit on AlembicAgent main and return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, command outputs, and residual risks.
